quests.name: Goblins? In MY Woods?
quests.summary: Captain Bramble would like fewer goblins. Any fewer.

dialog.offer: Goblins have been wandering out of Goblinwood again. Bonk six of them, would you? For the paperwork I need exactly six. Seven is a whole different form.
dialog.progress: Still counting goblins? Lovely. Keep at it. Count out loud if it helps.
dialog.complete: Six goblins! The paperwork sings! Here, this bow was gathering dust. And spiders. Mostly spiders.

quests.name: Rock and Stone (Mostly Rock)
quests.summary: Hilda needs copper ore. She did not say please. She never says please.

dialog.offer: You've got the look of someone who hits things. Go hit some copper veins. Four ore. The shiny rocks in the meadow, not the boring ones.
dialog.progress: No copper? The rocks won't mine themselves. I've asked. Politely, even.
dialog.complete: Now THAT is ore! Take my spare gloves. Don't ask what happened to my good ones. Or my eyebrows.

quests.name: Sniff Responsibly
quests.summary: Granny Gristle needs Sniffleleaf for her potions. They glow. Do not lick them.

dialog.offer: My nose isn't what it used to be, dearie. Fetch me five sprigs of Sniffleleaf. They glow a bit. Don't lick them. Again.
dialog.progress: Five sprigs, dearie. Follow your nose. Well, follow mine, it's pointing at the meadow.
dialog.complete: Achoo! Perfect. I've stitched you a bigger potion belt. One more swig of Questionable Health Potion, on the house.

quests.name: Wagon Wheel Wipeout
quests.summary: Goblins keep coming back for the rest of Pip's wagon. Defend it.

dialog.offer: They're coming back for the rest of my wagon! Help me hold them off! I'll... supervise. From behind this barrel.
dialog.progress: They're still coming! Do the shooty thing!
dialog.complete: You saved it! Most of it! Take this, I insist. I've decided it's yours now. No take-backs.

quests.name: Camp Crasher
quests.summary: The goblins answer to Warboss Snagtooth. Crash his camp north of the crossroads.

dialog.offer: All these goblins answer to one Warboss Snagtooth. He wears a hat with horns. On purpose. Head north from the crossroads and crash his camp.
dialog.accept: Hat with horns. On purpose. Got it.
dialog.progress: Snagtooth's camp is north of Wagon Crossroads. Follow the smell of soup.
dialog.complete: You toppled Snagtooth? Ha! The hat was clearly compensating. Now... about the bad news.

quests.name: Nothing Suspicious Here
quests.summary: Granny insists there is nothing suspicious about the hollow east of the goblin camp.

dialog.offer: There's a little hollow east of the goblin camp, dearie. Nothing suspicious there. Nothing at ALL. There's definitely not a chest. Go not-look at it.
dialog.progress: East of the goblin camp. Squeeze through the trees. Mind the mushrooms, they gossip.
dialog.complete: Oh, you found the chest? Fancy that. What a total, complete, utter surprise.

quests.name: Absolutely Unbearable
quests.summary: The goblins were worshipping something large. Something with honey on its breath. Defeat Grizzlefang.

dialog.offer: The goblins weren't the real problem. They were worshipping something. Something large. Grizzlefang lives in the hollow past the Old Plank Bridge. Please don't die; the paperwork for THAT is enormous.
dialog.progress: Grizzlefang's Hollow is west over the bridge, then north. Watch his charges. He can't turn worth a darn, and he HATES rocks.
dialog.complete: You beat Grizzlefang?! I'm writing a song about it. It's mostly screaming, but it's a song. Goblinwood owes you, hero.
